source_refs.note: 1. Menstrual Phase (Days 1-5): a main subheading of Female Reproductive Cycle - The Menstrual Cycle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 79-79.

blocks.text: Is phase mein endometrium ki functional layer jhar jati hai. Alag hua tissue aur khoon jism se bahar aate hain; isi ko menstruation (haiz) kehte hain. Yeh 3-5 din jari rehta hai. Yeh estrogen aur progesterone hormones ki kam miqdar ki wajah se hota hai. Is phase mein gonadotropins aur FSH barhna shuru ho jate hain (kitab ke alfaaz; FSH khud bhi ek gonadotropin hai).
